changes.text:
Credit confirmed accurate — PR #25 was exactly an L1_REPRODUCTION run of REMORA's reference effect-evidence verifier (`run-edge.sh --local`, matches the PR title itself), not an independently implemented APS verifier. No corrections needed on our line.

Preferred representation: Pablo Etcheverry — Founder & CEO, Rama (building Mycelium Trails). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pablo-etcheverry-5924119/ — happy to be tagged there, and/or credited as Mycelium Trails / @giskard09 if that fits the layout better. Either or both work for us.

changes.author: giskard09
changes.title: ToolUsage retries a failed tool call twice per outer attempt, not once (schema-args-filter fallback in _use/_ause)
changes.text: +1 to reopening — this is still open (confirmed against examples/conformance/crewai-unguarded-retry), not resolved by any of #7452/#7454/#7458/#7590, none of which appear validated against a shared regression yet. Happy to help validate: a fixture asserting at most one tool-body invocation per outer attempt, across sync and async paths, would settle which PR (if any) actually closes the gap.

changes.author: giskard09
changes.title: Proposal: a federation for neutral open-source AI infrastructure
changes.text: Count Rama/Mycelium Trails in — happy to tag, share, and be tagged. Checkable thing from our side: AnchorRegistry (Base/Arbitrum One, permissionless — anyone can independently recompute the action_ref, no API key or operator trust required), with real production trails settling today. Happy to point to a specific tx when it's our turn. Attribution preference already left on #39.

changes.author: giskard09
changes.title: Proposal: Evidence Record Spec, a testable data model for the E4 tamper-evident evidence gap
changes.text:
Took the evidence record format for a spin against a real, non-synthetic case — no fixture, no contact with anyone, just a public already-settled event.

Built `er-rama-agent-bounties-001`: cites a real `BountySettled` event from `NSPG13/agent-bounties` (production, Base mainnet, OpenAI Build Week 2026 collab) — independently re-verified against `mainnet.base.org` directly, not trusted from their API. We didn't create, claim, or settle the bounty; we didn't contact NSPG13. Full provenance: [giskard09/agent-bounties-action-ref-anchor](https://github.com/giskard09/agent-bounties-action-ref-ancho
